root_cause.text: The `CQE_F_MASK` constant in `io_uring/net.c` omitted `IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE`, causing the flag to be incorrectly discarded or retained as stale during the bundle receive retry flag merge logic.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the `CQE_F_MASK` definition to include `IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE`, and the commit message explains that the previous omission caused the merge logic `cflags = req->cqe.flags | (cflags & CQE_F_MASK)` to silently drop the flag when `io_kbuf_inc_commit()` set it during incremental buffer consumption, leading to userspace advancing the ring head past entries the kernel still uses.
